description: Image Description: The image features a vintage steam locomotive on a railway track. The locomotive is black and prominently displays the number "110" on its front. Two small American flags are mounted on top of the locomotive. Behind it, a boxcar is visible with the word "SOUTHERN" printed on its side, along with some numbers. The scene is outdoors, with a partly cloudy sky and some trees in the background. The perspective is from the front of the locomotive, showcasing the railway tracks
